Aircraft.name: Recreational - Yakyak
Aircraft.Instructions:
Yakyak By: bjac0
WASD (Pitch+Roll)
The Yakyak is built for leisurely strolls down cozy rivers, shallow waters, or - if you have a death wish and an absurd amount of free time - taking hundreds of nautical miles into tropical storms in the middle of the ocean to tip over and drown! The choice is yours...
